description: Defines the BbrSender class implementing the BBR congestion control algorithm for QUIC, including its modes, recovery states, debug state, and related methods.

classes.name: BbrSender
classes.description: Implements the BBR congestion control algorithm for QUIC, managing modes, recovery, bandwidth estimation, and pacing.

classes.name: BbrSender::DebugState
classes.description: Holds debug information for BBR state, useful for troubleshooting congestion control issues.

methods.name: InSlowStart
methods.description: Checks if the sender is in slow start phase.

methods.name: InRecovery
methods.description: Checks if the sender is in recovery mode.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures the sender based on provided QUIC configuration.

methods.name: ApplyConnectionOptions
methods.description: Applies connection options to the sender.

methods.name: AdjustNetworkParameters
methods.description: Adjusts internal parameters based on network conditions.

methods.name: SetInitialCongestionWindowInPackets
methods.description: Sets the initial congestion window size.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Handles congestion events, updating state based on ACKs and losses.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Handles logic when a packet is sent.

methods.name: OnPacketNeutered
methods.description: Handles logic when a packet is neutered.

methods.name: CanSend
methods.description: Determines if data can be sent based on current congestion state.

methods.name: PacingRate
methods.description: Returns the current pacing rate.

methods.name: BandwidthEstimate
methods.description: Returns the current bandwidth estimate.

methods.name: GetCongestionWindow
methods.description: Returns the current congestion window size.

methods.name: GetSlowStartThreshold
methods.description: Returns the slow start threshold.

methods.name: GetCongestionControlType
methods.description: Returns the type of congestion control used.

methods.name: GetDebugState
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current debug state.

methods.name: OnApplicationLimited
methods.description: Handles application-limited state.

methods.name: PopulateConnectionStats
methods.description: Populates connection statistics.

methods.name: num_startup_rtts
methods.description: Returns the number of RTTs in startup phase.

methods.name: has_non_app_limited_sample
methods.description: Checks if there is a non-application-limited sample.

methods.name: set_high_gain
methods.description: Sets the high gain value for startup.

methods.name: set_high_cwnd_gain
methods.description: Sets the high congestion window gain for startup.

methods.name: set_drain_gain
methods.description: Sets the drain gain.

methods.name: GetMinRtt
methods.description: Returns the current minimum RTT estimate.

methods.name: ExportDebugState
methods.description: Exports the current debug state for troubleshooting.
